answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The cedar holds work receipts rather than names, so the marble of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. By the relic of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
